opportunity: The optimistic oracle clears 3% on both development cases. This is permission for one bounded causal prototype, not a speed claim.
oracle_accounting_correction: The initial protocol described acceptance plus one bonus. Source and exact traces show checkpoint replay adds a second bonus when 12 - accepted exceeds the three retained recurrent states. The analyzer uses that actual transition, and prices it optimistically at the minimum observed lookup cost.

policy.scope: Experimental opt-in for exactly ngram-simple plus draft-mtp, one state record per sequence; no target sampling, draft-length, checkpoint-capacity or fixture changes.
policy.reset: Reset on common_speculative_begin; do not transfer learning across requests.
policy.warmup: Four observed MTP rounds before lookup can be selected.
policy.initial_lookup: Try the first eligible proposal after the warmup to initialize its cost.
policy.cost: Elapsed monotonic time from speculative drafting entry to final accept callback divided by committed tokens. Replayed rejection remains part of the original round; accept callback length plus one includes its extra token.
policy.estimate: EWMA of microseconds per committed token, alpha 0.25, separately for each source.
policy.selection: Use lookup only when its estimated cost is at most MTP cost / 1.03.
policy.exploration: When lookup is estimated unprofitable, bypass fifteen eligible proposals and probe the sixteenth. No parameter sweep after observing results.
policy.limitations: An action's estimate includes its own measured round, but not a separately predicted downstream switching penalty. No claim of optimality or workload generality.

screen.control: Installed files, which match the original owned-build common/server DLL hashes.
screen.candidate: Same installed files except freshly built llama-common.dll with the opt-in policy; no per-round diagnostic logging.
screen.fixed_configuration: Original target, Q4_K draft head, MTP3, ngram-simple n=m=12, ub512, dynamic vocabulary 16384, reasoning off.
screen.stop: Stop at the first failed pair; retain source patch, policy and measurement evidence without deployment.
screen.survivor: Require reversed order, complete natural-EOS AST/JSON edits, and release gates before any promotion.
